findings.description: Simultaneous-door behavior verified deterministic: the door selector checks cashmachine/posting first, then headcorner/active (unit-tested with a both-match synthetic list → cashmachine/posting wins). Impossible for distinct master passwords (one value cannot derive two different accounts' authorities); reachable only if the operator deliberately set the same public key on two authorities. In that case the receipt's matches[] records BOTH matches, so the situation stays visible and reversible. Acceptable as designed.

findings.description: The receipt publishes valueKind ('wif' vs 'master-password') — metadata about the FORM of the delivered vault value. The alternative (hiding it) would cost diagnostic value in exactly the scenario this delivery exists for (the identification). Judged acceptable; recorded for the record.
